## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Include a short before/after
example when useful.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Include browser evidence for UI changes
and a reproducer/regression test for bug fixes. State any verification limit.

## Compatibility and scope

Note affected feature/shared contracts, stored-data changes or migration behavior.
Remove this section when there is no material compatibility effect. Link related
issues, proposals or decisions when relevant.
